x_1755386_safetr_0_bfd_policy_knowledge.guidance_text: For ATM cash disputes, obtain the electronic journal (EJ) and end-of-day cash-balancing report. Credit the customer for any confirmed shortfall. Provisional credit applies where evidence is pending beyond SLA.
